area: Ark escort tuning and the ecology lure carve-out (ECOSYSTEM.md 0.z)
summary: Fauna now attack the Ark in announced assaults: the escort's lure on the Ark's world rises to a new tier AssaultLureShare (0.45 d1 to 0.95 d9) until the squad kills N attackers near the Ark or it times out. Breach lines back at d1-d3 (0.25), since below armour-bite tiers the Ark could not be lost. Job voyages' hostile cells (new per-job hostileCells) now use the same lure, assaults and armour-as-food at the escort's tier: a second caller of SetFeedingLure, widening the 0.z carve-out. Not sim-tuned; the chaos ladder was fitted without assaults, so d4+ is harder now. Milestone 1, Shombith 2026-11-16.
